title: Police shoot dead a man in crisis and armed with knives
subtitle: Taxi drivers watched him while waiting for the arrival of the Sûreté du Québec.
article: An armed man, apparently in crisis, was shot dead by the Sûreté du Québec a few metres from his home Friday evening in Mauricie, after first being monitored by taxi drivers.
Benoit Chabot, 26, often walked around in slippers and pyjamas, even outside in the winter, in the 7th Avenue area of the Grand-Mère neighbourhood in Shawinigan.
He was sometimes seen rummaging through ashtrays looking for cigarette butts that were not completely smoked, according to witnesses interviewed Saturday by Le Journal.
Several reported that he also sometimes talked to himself, yelled, and seemed to be in crisis over the past few weeks.
On Friday night, Chabot reportedly began wandering the street armed with knives, according to the Bureau of Independent Investigations, which is responsible for shedding light on this case.
He was first spotted by a Bellemare Taxi driver, whose office is nearby on the same avenue. The driver informed his dispatcher, who then contacted police around 9:30 p.m.
"I told him to keep his attention," said Maxime Drolet, the company's general manager, who was at the office at the time.
"They had one car in front of him and one car behind him," continued Mr. Drolet, who stayed in contact with his drivers over the radio.
He could see a bit of what was happening from a distance, and in his view, there was no doubt the man was dangerous.
"He was aggressive, he was not in a normal state," said the manager.
The Sûreté du Québec arrived within minutes, and the officers reportedly ordered him to drop his knives.
They also attempted to subdue him with a conducted energy weapon, without success.

"The man did not comply with the officers' orders and instead moved toward them in a threatening manner. One of the officers then used his firearm, fatally hitting the civilian," according to initial information from the Bureau of Independent Investigations.
The individual was shot dead in the yard of the building where he lived, just a few metres from the stairs leading to his home.
